title: Kenyan Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan-inspired vegetable stew, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is vegetarian-friendly and can be easily adapted to suit your taste preferences.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and bell peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, jinja, and friendly spice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for another 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with some crusty bread.
